current_state.zh: 在发生涉及该代币的第三方安全事件后，Coinbase 已暂停充值，并将 Coinbase Exchange 和 Coinbase Advanced 上的 WMTX-USD 交易对转为仅限价模式；限价单可下单和取消，可能发生成交，市价单无法提交。资产发行方正在积极调查此事，我们将提供最新进展。
current_state.en: Coinbase paused deposits and moved the WMTX-USD trading pair to limit-only mode on Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase Advanced following a third-party security incident involving the token; limit orders can be placed and canceled and matches may occur, while market orders cannot be submitted. The asset issuer is actively investigating the issue and updates will be provided as available.
